Summary: The first author of the paper "Attention Is All You Need" is Ashish Vaswani. The paper lists eight authors in randomized order, all of whom were "equal contributors." observations.content:
Summary: The first author of the "Attention Is All You Need" paper is Ashish Vaswani. The paper, published in 2017, was authored by eight scientists and engineers working at Google, including Ashish Vaswani, Noam Shazeer, Niki Parmar, Jakob Uszkoreit, Llion Jones, Aidan Gomez, Łukasz Kaiser, and Illia Polosukhin. All eight authors were "equal contributors" to the paper, and the listed order was randomized according to the paper itself. The paper introduced a new deep learning architecture known as the transformer, which has become a foundational model for a wide variety of artificial intelligence systems.

The transformer approach it describes has become the main architecture of a wide variety of artificial intelligence systems, including large language [...] The paper's title is a reference to the song "All You Need Is Love" by the Beatles. The name "Transformer" was picked because Jakob Uszkoreit, one of the paper's authors, liked the sound of that word. An early design document was titled "Transformers: Iterative Self-Attention and Processing for Various Tasks", and included an illustration of six characters from the Transformers franchise.
